ideas.name: any warning in a mean-reverting tape
ideas.why: 1m returns over the last hour with lag-1 autocorrelation under -0.1: each move is being taken back, so the tape itself rewards fading

ideas.name: any warning with the hour's variance ratio under 0.8
ideas.why: 5-minute moves over the hour smaller than five 1-minute moves would give (variance ratio under 0.8): the market is rotating, not trending

ideas.name: any warning after a move made of jumps
ideas.why: if the last 30 minutes' biggest bar is over a third of all the price travelled, the move came in a jump (stops, a headline), not steady buying, and jumps get faded

ideas.name: any warning at the hour's range edge, calling inside
ideas.why: price in the outer fifth of the last 60 minutes' range and the warning calling back inside: the hour's rotation turning at its edge
